extraction.name: DocVQA
extraction.description: A dataset for Visual Question Answering (VQA) on document images consisting of 50,000 questions defined on 12,767 document images sourced from the UCSF Industry Documents Library across various industries, document types, and timeframes.
extraction.creator: Minesh Mathew, Dimosthenis Karatzas, C.V. Jawahar
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Documents were downloaded from different collections in the UCSF Industry Documents Library, and pages were hand-picked prioritizing non-binarized images and pages with tables, forms, lists, and figures over running text. Questions and answers were collected using remote workers via a web-based annotation tool in three stages.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were selected minimizing binarized images to avoid poor image quality. For BERT-style reading comprehension baselines, OCR tokens recognized on the document images were serialized to a single string separated by space in top-left to bottom-right order, and answer spans were approximated using the first match of the answer string in the serialized OCR string.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations were collected in three stages using a web-based tool: Stage 1 asked remote workers to define at most 10 question-answer pairs per document image, entering answers verbatim from the text and allowing multiple ground truth answers. Stage 2 verified data where another worker, blind to Stage 1 answers, entered answers and assigned one or more of 9 question types, with an option to flag inapt questions. Stage 3 sent questions where Stage 1 and Stage 2 answers had no exact match to the authors for review, editing, or removal.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: A Web based annotation tool supported by Amazon
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: If none of the answers entered in the first stage matched exactly with any of the answers from the second stage, the question was sent for review in a third stage handled by the authors, where questions and answers could be edited, accepted, or ignored. Questions flagged for language issues or ambiguity in stage 2 were excluded.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Models need to improve specifically on questions where understanding the structure of the document is crucial, such as understanding figures, diagrams, and text on photographs. Performance is also bottlenecked by OCR errors and handwriting recognition limitations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Visual Question Answering on document images, document layout analysis, machine reading comprehension on document images; divided into training (39,463 questions, 10,194 images), validation (5,349 questions, 1,286 images), and testing (5,188 questions, 1,287 images) splits.
